notes: E-Hub is in the app: browse the catalog, open product pages, discover sellers and service providers, view their profiles and send enquiries.
E-Hub Seller Center: set up your storefront, add and edit products, and see how your shop is doing.
Business account: create and manage your business profile from the app.
Course lessons: watch lesson videos, take quizzes and open lesson files (PDF, Word) without leaving the app.
Assignments: hand in a written answer and files, then see your grade and your instructor's feedback.
New progress & grades page for each course: completion, average quiz score and your result for every lesson.
Course reviews: read what other students say and leave your own rating.
Teach on Ourlime: apply to become an instructor, create and publish courses, and grade your students' work.
Events: a new event page with comments, plus a Calendar view that shows what's on each day.
Games: a new Games hub with Trini Wordle and Trini GeoGuesser. Find places across T&T on the map and climb the leaderboard.
Fixes: E-Learning and E-Hub screens that wouldn't load, Seller Center closing on open, broken card layouts, and member names that showed an email address.
